trajectory_summary: The call opens flat, moves through the verify checklist quickly but mechanically, and stalls when the customer — who is not home and confused about the call's purpose — presses for a price. The rep never flips the captured bill number into leverage and instead explains the bill-swap program unprompted, ending on a vague 'send me the bill, I'll text you' with no locked appointment.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown/unclear; based on the transcript this is a callback/no_appointment — no day or time was ever proposed or agreed, only a bill-text-back promise.
